integrity: Every asserted theorem has an analytic proof; finite Fourier tests are corroboration, not a universal certificate. Self-review only; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only three-point coordinate boxes on finite products of cycles of length at least three.
When some factor has even order, the complete higher-dimensional optimizer face is not classified; only nonuniqueness and an explicit continuum are proved.
The scalar Turán constant and its product law are prior mathematics, not the originality claim.
An implicit published equality-case classification not discovered in the literature review remains possible.
title: Spectral-hyperplane rigidity and the parity criterion for finite Turán boxes
